title: Introduce per-invocation lineage IDs, sampled event sidecar, and phase-aware token chargeback dashboard
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds per-invocation lineage IDs for trace correlation, a lightweight sampled-event sidecar for low-overhead structured logging, and a new token-phase chargeback dashboard with alert hooks and runbook links.
description: Summary: Adds a compact per-invocation lineage identifier, a deployable event-sidecar that performs reservoir sampling of structured invocation events, and a phase-aware token chargeback dashboard (UI + queries + alert tuning). Motivation: customers asked for faster root-cause access when token cost spikes and for cheaper, correlated logs that don't increase cardinality in primary traces. The lineage ID lets teams surface a single stable key in traces, logs, and billing lookups; the sidecar samples rich structured events (prompt/phase markers, quantization flag, kernel hints) and forwards them to the telemetry bus; the dashboard ties token counts to invocation phases so teams can reason about chargebacks per-phase. Design highlights: - Lineage ID: deterministic 64-bit stable ID derived from request id + model-version + route fingerprint (collision resistant, reversible for debug only via internal index). Stored in span attribute "inv.lineage" and emitted in HTTP header X-Inv-Lineage for private deployments. - Event sidecar: Go service (pkg/sidecar/event_sampler.go) runs as a per-node sidecar, attaches to the local ingestion socket, performs time-windowed reservoir sampling, emits compact JSON events to the telemetry bus (Kafka/KSQ) and writes a minimal sidecar metric (sidecar.sample.rate, sidecar.drop.rate). Sampling policy is multi-tier: always-sample on errors, adaptive reservoir for heavy tenants, and static 1-per-100 for low priority routes. - Phase-aware token chargeback: new dashboard observability/dashboards/token_phase_chargeback.json that aggregates tokens by labeled phases (init/prefix/gen/postprocess), attributes GPU/CPU split where available, and computes per-tenant per-route chargeback tables for accounting. Alerts: a new alert (TokenPhaseChargebackSpike) triggers when a route shows >20% increase in tokens for 'postprocess' over a rolling 30m baseline with adaptive hysteresis to reduce churn. Checklist: - [x] Add lineage generator and attach to serving runtime (src/serving/lineage_id.py) - [x] Emit header in private/VPC variants - [x] Implement event sidecar (pkg/sidecar/event_sampler.go) with unit tests - [x] Add sampling metrics and dashboards - [x] Create chargeback dashboard and alert rule - [x] Add runbook and playbook links (docs/runbooks/token_chargeback_playbook.md) - [x] Add integration tests and perf microbenchmarks Commits (summary): - a1f3b2c: feature(lineage): deterministic per-invocation lineage id + header emission + unit tests - b7c4d99: feat(sidecar): add reservoir sampler, config knobs, and telemetry sinks; add sidecar e2e harness - c3d9f11: obs(dashboard): token phase chargeback dashboard + alert rule + runbook link - d5e0a20: test: integration tests for sampled events and lineage correlation - f0b6c6a: perf: microbenchmark for lineage overhead and sidecar CPU utilization Changed files (high level): - src/serving/lineage_id.py (new) - internal/trace/attributes.go (add inv.lineage propagation) - pkg/sidecar/event_sampler.go (new) - pkg/sidecar/config.yaml (new) - observability/dashboards/token_phase_chargeback.json (new) - monitoring/alerts/token_phase_rules.yaml (updated) - docs/runbooks/token_chargeback_playbook.md (new) - tests/integration/test_sidecar_sampling.py (new) - tests/perf/test_lineage_overhead.bench (new) - pkg/telemetry/forwarder_kafka.go (small hookup) - go.mod / python requirements (minor bumps) Testing & perf: - Unit tests: all pass locally and in CI. - Integration: sidecar e2e ran in staging; validated that ~1% sampling yields <0.4% CPU overhead on a busy node. - Perf: microbenchmark shows lineage_id generation adds ~55ns on hot path; negligible impact on 99th latency in our bench. - Security: header emission gated behind deployment config and KMS access; no PII stored in sampled events. CI summary: - lint: pass - unit: pass - integration: pass (staging run flake → rerun → pass) - e2e: pass - perf-bench: pass - security-scan: pass Merge notes: Merged via squash by Nadia Kumar after approvals. Squash commit message: "inv-lineage + event-sidecar + token-phase-chargeback: add lineage IDs, sampled event sidecar, UI and alerts" Rollout plan & follow-ups: - Feature gated; default sampling set low for all tenants. - Recommend enabling lineage header in Private customers with opt-in; add telemetry->billing join job in next sprint to populate chargeback tables. - Follow-up tasks created: ENG-1102 (billing-join job), ENG-1103 (enable tenant-level sampling UI), ENG-1104 (add long-term retention pipeline for sidecar events). Links: - Linear board: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1045 - Runbook: docs/runbooks/token_chargeback_playbook.md - Staging dashboard (internal): /dashboards/token_phase_chargeback (internal URL) Notes: This PR focuses on low-overhead observability improvements for token-cost and latency debugging without increasing trace cardinality; design favors sampled structured events and a stable lineage key to quickly correlate traces, logs, and billing.
